description: Create a user. With merchant_id, uses the merchant's x-api-key scope; without it, creates an org user and requires JWT (RINNE_EMAIL/RINNE_PASSWORD).

merchant_id.description: Merchant ID to scope this call to (uses /v1/merchants/{merchant_id}/...). Omit to act at the organization/self level with an org-scoped key.

name: create_user
